content.text: Let me test the zero-partition code path directly and a few scoring edge cases:

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - << 'EOF'
import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, 'submission')
import main as M

# zero-partition output shape (monkeypatch infer to return Z=0)
orig_infer = M.infer
M.infer = lambda factors, n: (0, None)
doc = {"version":1,"ixps":[],"rib":[{"path":[1,2,3],"count":1}],
       "priors":[],"declared":[],"order":[[1,2],[2,3]],"queries":[{"id":"q","path":[1,2,3],"threshold":[1,2]}]}
res = M.solve(M.validate(doc))
print("zero-partition output:", json.dumps(res))
assert res == {"error": "zero-partition"}
M.infer = orig_infer

# ties in triple minimum -> earliest witness
doc = {"version":1,"ixps":[],"rib":[],
       "priors":[],"declared":[],
       "order":[],
       "queries":[{"id":"t","path":[7,8,9,10,11],"threshold":[0,1]}]}
res = M.solve(M.validate(doc))
q = res['queries'][0]
print("all-uniform ties:", q)
assert q['witness'] == 0 and abs(q['score'] - 5/9) < 1e-12

# threshold exactly equal to the score -> not leaked
doc2 = {"version":1,"ixps":[],"rib":[],"priors":[],"declared":[],"order":[],
        "queries":[{"id":"e","path":[7,8,9],"threshold":[15,27]}]}  # 5/9 = 15/27
res2 = M.solve(M.validate(doc2))
print("equality case:", res2['queries'][0])
assert res2['queries'][0]['leaked'] is False

# threshold just above -> leaked
doc3 = {"version":1,"ixps":[],"rib":[],"priors":[],"declared":[],"order":[],
        "queries":[{"id":"l","path":[7,8,9],"threshold":[16,27]}]}
res3 = M.solve(M.validate(doc3))
print("just above:", res3['queries'][0])
assert res3['queries'][0]['leaked'] is True

# declared p2p on a core link wins over the marginal for scoring but not links
doc4 = {"version":1,"ixps":[],"rib":[{"path":[41,67,109],"count":2},
                                     {"path":[67,109,41],"count":3},
                                     {"path":[109,41,67],"count":5}],
        "priors":[{"link":[41,67],"weights":[1,0,0]}],
        "declared":[{"link":[41,67],"rel":"p2p"}],
        "order":[[41,67],[41,109],[67,109]],
        "queries":[{"id":"d","path":[41,67,109],"threshold":[1,2]},
                   {"id":"r","path":[67,41],"threshold":[1,2]}]}
res4 = M.solve(M.validate(doc4))
print("decl+prior on core:", json.dumps(res4['links'][0]))
for q in res4['queries']: print("   ", q)
# link record must use the marginal, not the prior/declaration
assert res4['links'][0]['prob'] == [0.196, 0.314, 0.49]
print("OK")
EOF
